summary: One-line change swaps `_default_manager` for `_base_manager` in ForeignKey.validate(), which is exactly the fix the issue requests and matches Django's accepted resolution. Minimal, correct, and uses the right abstraction; no merge-blocking problems.

issues.description: Subtle behavior change: validation no longer applies the default manager's filters, so projects that relied on default-manager scoping during FK validation see different results. This is the intended fix and well-documented in the issue, but warrants a release note mention.
No accompanying docs/release-note update in the diff to flag the validation-manager change for users; maintainers typically add a short note, though not merge-blocking.
